name: Crone Hellebron
canonNotes: The oldest Hag Queen and greatest Bride of Khaine, whose youth now fades faster after each blood-bath.
Leads Khaine's murderous rites; loathes Morathi, who withheld the deepest secrets of the cauldrons.
voiceNotes: Bitter, zealous and murderous; speaks of Khaine and blood.
Venomous toward Morathi, contemptuous of weakness.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
